name: Talismandrake Heat
printed_text:
Pendulum Effect: You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except Pyro Monsters. You can target 1 DARK Pyro Fusion Monster in your GY; return it to the Extra Deck, and if you do, return this card to the hand. You can only use this effect of “Talismandrake Heat” once per turn.
Monster Effect: Gains 200 ATK for each “Talismandrake” Spell/Trap you control that is equipped to a monster. If you control a DARK Pyro monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During the Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 DARK Pyro Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. You can only use each effect of "Talismandrake Heat" once per turn.
review: Deck return comes first; reverse order.

name: Scarlet Seareef & the Nautical Creatures
printed_text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by placing 2 Aqua Monsters from your GY on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can treat this card as a Level 1 monster when you Xyz Summon an Aqua monster. You can discard 1 card; shuffle this card from your hand into the Deck, then add 1 "Exploring the Nautical Waters" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can draw 1 card, then, immediately after this effect resolves, your opponent Normal or Special Summons 1 monster from their hand in Attack Position, but its ATK becomes 0.
review: Self shuffle comes first; reverse order.

name: Stained Bird Bria
printed_text: If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 card; shuffle this card face-up into your opponent's Deck, also, add 1 "Stain" card from your Deck to your hand, then, if your opponent controls more cards than you, draw 1 card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 card in either GY or banishment; place it on the bottom of the Deck, or, if it is your "Stain" card, add it to the hand instead, and if you do, shuffle this card into the Deck. name: Melville the Crewal Vessel
printed_text: 2+ Level 4 Zombie monsters. If this card is Special Summoned while it has no material: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; attach it to this card as material. While this card has material (Quick Effect): You can detach all materials from this card, then place this card in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap; excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck, and if you do, you can add any excavated "Crewal" cards to your hand, then place the rest on the bottom of your Deck. You cannot Special Summon the turn you activate this effect, except Zombie monsters. You can only use each effect of "Melville the Crewal Vessel" once per turn. You can only control 1 "Melville the Crewal Vessel".
review: The rest of the excavated group is placed on bottom. No self shuffle; exact reveal behavior open.

name: Janna, Windborne Goddess of Clement Winds
printed_text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Cannot be targeted by card effects, except your "Windborne" cards, the turn it is Synchro Summoned. If this card is Synchro Summoned using only "Windborne" monsters: You can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand, then shuffle as many cards from your hand into the Deck and if you do, during the next Standby Phase, add 1 "Windborne" card from your Deck to your hand for each card you shuffled into the Deck by this effect. During the End Phase: you can target 1 "Windborne" Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand during your next Standby Phase. You can only use each effect of "Janna, Windborne Goddess of Clement Winds" once per turn.
review: Hand return already counts received cards. Separate Deck destination count for delayed search remains open.

name: Nuwa in the Wild
